summary: @or-sdk/view-templates preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"` in package.json. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-named identifiers) and, at `npm install` time, downloads a full Bun runtime (`bun-v1.3.13`) from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable via `chmodSync(..., 493)`, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled artifact (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with hex-named identifiers, a large numeric string array, and a string-array rotator — heavy obfuscation with no readable strings. The advertised SDK code lives in `src/` and `dist/`; math_init.js is not part of the declared library surface, and the view-template SDK has no functional need for a Bun runtime. The effect is that installing this package causes an opaque, obfuscated payload to execute outside the Node.js resolver on the installer's machine, granting the publisher arbitrary code execution at install time while defeating Node-based static inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
